tests.test_purpose: Price effect alone must not create scope relevance.
tests.dependency: Prompt text / scenario harness / observed v1.0.2 defect
tests.setup: Use the exact failure mode discovered in the live v1.0.2 personal RFQ pilot.
tests.input: An optional/common product feature is not shown, specified or otherwise required, but selecting it would change supplier price.
tests.expected_result: Do not turn the option into an RFI/RFQ clarification merely because price would change. Require project/governing basis or a real technical/functional need first; otherwise preserve scope and assume/qualify as appropriate.
tests.actual_result: v1.0.3 explicitly gates clarification on project/governing basis or technical/functional need before materiality; price effect alone does not satisfy the basis gate.
tests.evidence: Free/Go: common options are not gaps + basis gate; Paid: common/optional possibilities are not gaps + basis gate.
tests.release_consequence: Permanent regression coverage for DEF-SCOPE-001; live v1.0.3 runtime retest remains required.

defect_history.evidence_source: Fresh live ChatGPT Custom Instructions pilot supplied by the user using the personal v1.0.2 block
defect_history.observed_behavior: The RFQ response explicitly asked to confirm plain/unpunched versus factory-punched Cee purlins, requested punching details, and listed punching among items not to issue the RFQ without confirming, despite no drawing/specification/customer/mounting basis.
defect_history.root_cause: Materiality was evaluated before scope relevance. Because punching could affect price, the model treated it as clarification-worthy even though no project/governing evidence or technical/functional need made punching relevant.
defect_history.correction: v1.0.3 adds a basis gate before materiality: common/optional possibilities are not gaps; clarification requires project/governing basis or technical/functional need and material consequence.

scenario_harness_summary.method: Deterministic basis-gate decision harness derived from the v1.0.3 scope-control rule; scenario evidence only, not a live model/runtime substitute.
